summary.text: Keith Kempenich is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives who has represented District 39 since 1992 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Kempenich attended Black Hills State in 1980, according to Ballotpedia.
His professional experience includes working as a rancher, a crop adjuster and the owner of Box K Trucking.

Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments in the 2023-2024 session as vice chair of the House Appropriations Committee and membership on the Appropriations - Government Operations Division Committee.
